data.one_liner: PMTiles tile provider for vector_map_tiles using HTTP Range Requests.
data.what_it_does: Provides a tile provider for vector_map_tiles and flutter_map to support PMTiles. It enables requesting vector tiles from a single local file or a hosted remote file using HTTP Range Requests.
use_when: You are using flutter_map and vector_map_tiles in your application
You need to render vector map tiles from local or hosted PMTiles files
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_map or vector_map_tiles
Your map tiles are served through standard raster tile URLs instead of PMTiles archives
strengths: Supports loading tiles from both local file system paths and remote URLs
Integrates seamlessly with flutter_map and vector_map_tiles
Includes Protomaps basemap themes out of the box
weaknesses: Mapbox, OpenMapTiles, and standard raster map styles are not compatible with Protomaps styles
Requires awaiting a future to initialize the tile provider
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_map and vector_map_tiles_pmtiles to your pubspec.yaml and initialize the tile provider from a source URL or local path.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard map layers and markers without vector tile or PMTiles support.
